full_text_zh:
[P1] 给孩子的山海经神话绘本
息壤失窃
孟惜 编 [越]阮氏慧 绘
福建科学技术出版社
海豚传媒（北京）文化传播有限公司出品

[P2] 给孩子的山海经神话绘本
息壤失窃
孟惜 编 [越]阮氏慧 绘
国家开放大学出版社出版
国开童媒(北京)文化有限公司出品

[P3] 相传在很久很久以前的上古时代，一场巨大的洪水席卷了大地。汹涌的洪水所到之处，都变成一片汪洋。
大水冲塌了房屋，淹没了庄稼。人们扶老携幼，逃到高高的大山上。可山上还有各种毒蛇猛兽威胁着他们的生命。洪水过境，气温骤降又没有食物，很多人被冻死饿死了。

[P4] 有一个天神，名叫鲧，他是黄帝的孙子。鲧奉天帝之命治理水患。但洪水太过凶猛，鲧一直没有找到好的办法治理。

[P5] 立功心切的鲧听说天帝有一样宝物，叫息壤，那是一种极其珍贵的神奇土壤。传说只需要把一小块息壤投向大地，它就可以自由生长，长成高山，堆成堤坝，堵住洪水。而且，洪水每上涨一寸，用息壤堆积而成的堤坝也会随之长高一寸。

[P6] 可是，息壤是天帝珍视的宝物，每天随身携带着。天帝并不想把息壤借给鲧。鲧不死心，一直伺机偷窃息壤。终于有一天机会来了，鲧趁天帝睡着的时候偷走了息壤。

[P8] 鲧把息壤扔在地上，果然土壤马上堆积成堤……洪水似乎更凶猛，不停地漫过息壤筑成的堤坝，息壤果然神力无边，一直在生长。

[P9] 很快，天帝就发现了息壤被偷。他勃然大怒，
派火神祝融夺回了息壤，把鲧杀死在羽山的郊野。
人间大地依旧是一片洪荒。

[P10] 鲧虽然被处死，但尸体三年没有腐烂。天帝知道后，派了一个天神到羽山脚下，用一柄宝刀剖开了鲧的肚子。没想到，从鲧的肚子里钻出了一条虬龙，飞上了云霄，这虬龙是禹的神魂。

[P11] 他勘测水情，亲手绘制水情图。哪里深，哪里浅；哪里好冲堤，哪里易决口；哪里该挖，哪里该堵；哪里能断水，哪里可排洪……他都画得一清二楚。

鲧孕育了禹，禹也接替了鲧的使命。他发誓一定要与滔天的洪水斗争到底，彻底治理好水患。于是，禹的足迹踏遍了万水千山。

[P12] 禹手下有一些得力的干将帮助他。有一个叫做竖亥的神，行走速度极快。禹命令他步行测量大地的长度，竖亥花了一天时间，自东极走到西极，走了五亿十万九千八百步。

[P13] 禹用自己的智慧，团结
各路天神和百姓，坚韧不拔
地和洪水打着持久战。一路上，禹不仅开山引水，还斩
妖除魔，造福人间。

共工有一个臣子叫相繇，是一个九头蛇怪。
他吃人无数，只要他喷吐停留过的地方，立即变
成沼泽，气味辛辣而且苦涩，生机俱灭。

[P14] 禹听说后，挺身而出，杀死了相繇。
可九头蛇怪的血又腥又臭，血水流到之处，
水涝成灾，谷物不能生长，人也不能居住。

[P15] 禹费尽心思，想用土来填塞这片有毒的土地。然而，
屡次填塞，屡次塌陷。于是，禹把那儿挖成大池子，各
方天神利用挖出的泥土在昆仑山的北面建造了几座高
台，镇住妖气。这片有毒的土地于是被治理好了。

[P16] 天帝也被禹的决心和行动所打动，将息壤借给了他。疏导和填塞的方法并用，禹最终战胜了洪水。从此，天下划定成九州，人民安居乐业，一片祥和。
full_text_en:
[P1] Mythology Picture Book from the Classic Shan Hai Jing for Children
The Theft of Xirang
Compiled by Meng Xi, Illustrated by [Vietnam] Nguyen Thi Hoi
Fujian Science and Technology Press
Dolphin Media (Beijing) Cultural Communication Co., Ltd.

[P2] Mythological Picture Book from the Classic Shan Hai Jing for Children
The Theft of Xirang
Compiled by Meng Xi, Illustrated by [Vietnam] Nguyen Thi Hoi
Published by Open University Press
Produced by Guokai Children's Media (Beijing) Culture Co., Ltd.

[P3] It is said that long, long ago, in ancient times, a massive flood swept across the land. Wherever the surging floodwaters reached, everything turned into a vast ocean.

The flood destroyed houses and drowned crops. People, carrying the old and leading the young, fled to high mountains. But on the mountains, poisonous snakes and fierce beasts still threatened their lives. After the flood passed, temperatures dropped sharply and there was no food. Many people froze or starved to death.

[P4] There was a celestial deity named Gun, who was the grandson of the Yellow Emperor. Gun was ordered by the Heavenly Emperor to control the floods. But the floods were too fierce, and Gun had never found a good way to manage them.

[P5] Gung, eager to achieve merit, heard that the Heavenly Emperor possessed a treasure called Xirang, a highly precious and magical soil. Legend had it that if a small piece of Xirang were thrown to the earth, it could grow freely, forming high mountains and dams to block the floods. Moreover, for every inch the floodwaters rose, the dam built from Xirang would grow an inch taller.

[P6] However, Xirang was a treasured possession of the Heavenly Emperor, carried with him at all times. The Heavenly Emperor did not want to lend Xirang to Gun. Gun, however, did not give up, and kept looking for an opportunity to steal it. Finally, one day, the chance came—Gun stole Xirang while the Heavenly Emperor was asleep.

[P8] Gun threw the Xirang soil on the ground, and indeed, the soil immediately piled up into a dike... The flood seemed even more fierce, constantly overflowing the dike built from Xirang, yet the Xirang truly possessed boundless power, continuously growing.

[P9] Soon, the Heavenly Emperor discovered that the Xirang had been stolen. He became furious,
and sent the Fire God Zhurong to retrieve the Xirang, killing Gun in the outskirts of Yu Mountain.
The human world remained a vast wasteland of floods.

[P10] Gun was executed, but his body did not decay for three years. After learning this, the Heavenly Emperor sent a celestial deity to the foot of Yu Mountain, who used a sacred blade to open Gun's belly. Unexpectedly, a coiled dragon emerged from Gun's body, soared into the clouds, and this dragon was the divine spirit of Yu.

[P11] He surveyed the water conditions and personally drew detailed maps. Where it was deep, where it was shallow; where it was suitable for building dikes, where it was prone to breaches; where to dig, where to block; where to cut off the flow, where to drain... he mapped it all with perfect clarity.

Gun gave birth to Yu, and Yu took over Gun's mission. He vowed to fight the overwhelming floods to the end and completely resolve the water disaster. Thus, Yu's footsteps traversed countless rivers and mountains.

[P12] Yu had some capable assistants. One of them was a god named Shu Hai, who walked extremely fast. Yu ordered him to measure the length of the earth on foot. Shu Hai took one day to walk from the easternmost point to the westernmost point, covering five hundred million, ten thousand, nine thousand, and eight hundred steps.

[P13] Yu used his wisdom to unite
heavenly gods and common people, persistently
fighting a long war against the floods. Along the way, Yu not only opened mountains and diverted water, but also slew demons and monsters, bringing blessings to humanity.

Gonggong had a minister named Xiangyao, a nine-headed serpent monster.
He had eaten countless people; wherever he spat or lingered, the land immediately turned into a swamp, with a pungent, spicy, and bitter smell, and all life perished.

[P14] Yu, upon hearing this, stepped forward and killed Xiangyao.
But the blood of the nine-headed monster was foul and stinky; wherever it flowed,
there was flooding, crops could not grow, and people could not live.

[P15] Yu tried his best to fill in this poisonous land with earth. However,
he filled it repeatedly, only for it to collapse repeatedly. So, Yu dug a large pool there, and
the heavenly gods used the excavated soil to build several high
platforms on the northern side of Kunlun Mountain to suppress the demonic energy. This poisonous land was thus successfully managed.

[P16] The Heavenly Emperor was also moved by Yu's determination and actions, and lent him the Xirang soil. By combining the methods of channeling and filling, Yu finally triumphed over the floods. From then on, the world was divided into the Nine Provinces, and the people lived in peace and prosperity, enjoying a harmonious life.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《息壤失窃》的封面，展示了戴着斗笠、手持宝盒的神秘人物形象，背景有云纹和山海元素，标明了书名、编绘者及出版社信息。
[P2] 本页为绘本《息壤失窃》的封面，展示了书名、编绘者信息及出版社信息，配以山峰与波浪的插图，体现山海经神话主题。
[P3] 本页描绘了上古时代一场巨大洪水席卷大地的场景，房屋被毁、庄稼被淹，人们逃到山上避难，但面临毒蛇猛兽、严寒和饥饿的威胁。
[P4] 本页介绍了天神鲧奉天帝之命治理洪水，但因洪水过于凶猛而始终未能找到有效方法。
[P5] 本页讲述了鲧在治理洪水时，得知天帝拥有能随洪水上涨而自动生长的神奇土壤——息壤，并对其功效充满期待。
[P6] 鲧因天帝不愿借出息壤，便趁其熟睡时偷走了这珍贵的神土。
[P7] 画面描绘了鲧在天帝的宝库中偷取息壤的场景：右侧的鲧手持冒着紫烟的宝盒，神情专注；中间一人正用钥匙打开抽屉；左侧一人匆忙跑开，背景是布满神秘符号的储物柜，暗示偷窃行为正在进行。
[P8] 鲧将偷来的息壤扔在地上，土壤迅速堆积成堤坝，但洪水更加凶猛，不断漫过堤坝，而息壤持续生长，展现出神奇的力量。
[P9] 天帝发现息壤被盗后大怒，派火神祝融夺回息壤并将鲧杀死在羽山郊野，人间依旧洪水泛滥。
[P10] 鲧被处死后尸体三年不腐，天帝派天神剖开其腹，从中钻出一条虬龙飞上云霄，此龙即为禹的神魂。
[P11] 本页讲述了禹继承父亲鲧的遗志，决心治理洪水，他亲自勘测水情、绘制水图，并踏遍万水千山进行实地考察。
[P12] 本页讲述了大禹派遣神将竖亥步行测量大地长度，竖亥以极快的速度在一天内从东极走到西极，完成了对大地的测量。
[P13] 本页描绘了大禹治水过程中斩妖除魔的场景，同时介绍了共工的臣子相繇——一个九头蛇怪，其喷吐能使土地化为恶臭沼泽，危害人间。
[P14] 大禹为治理洪水，斩杀九头蛇怪相繇，但其血液污染土地，导致水涝成灾，谷物无法生长，百姓无法居住。
[P15] 大禹为治理被相繇血液污染的有毒土地，挖池填土，最终在各方天神协助下于昆仑山北面建造高台镇压妖气，成功治理了这片土地。
[P16] 天帝被大禹的决心打动，借给他息壤，大禹采用疏导与填塞结合的方法成功治水，天下被划分为九州，人民安居乐业，社会恢复祥和。
[P17] 画面中，一位身着红绿相间服饰、披着深色披风的英雄人物正从高处跃下，背景是连绵的山峦，整体呈现出大禹治水过程中跋山涉水、勇往直前的动态场景。
